args.description: A single white woolly SHEEP standing side-on, grazing, on a transparent background, seen from high above at a steep angle. Fat rounded fleece body, small dark head and legs, dark outline. Small and simple enough to read clearly at tiny size with several in a field. No ground, no grass, no fence, no sky, no shadow.
